why_best: It integrates the brand messaging into the physical world of the shot, delivering a high-production polish that makes the hero element feel larger than life.
why_bad: Slapping flat graphics across the foreground obscures our primary visual anchor and feels cheap, breaking the cinematic illusion.
trap: A failure to maintain tight spatial occlusion around the foreground subject's edges will make the lettering look like an unconvincing floating glitch.
